Windows NT.label: Windows
Windows NT.hint: Windows XP, 7, 10, 11, Windows Server and Xbox (NT kernel, not UNIX)

Windows (pre-NT).hint: DOS-based Windows before the NT kernel: 1.0, 2.0, 3.x, Windows 95, 98 and ME

OS/2.hint: IBM OS/2 and its continuations: Warp, eComStation, ArcaOS (not UNIX, not NT)

macOS.hint: macOS: Apple Darwin (XNU = Mach + BSD kernel) with a FreeBSD-derived userland; certified UNIX (UNIX 03)

Linux.hint: Everything with the Linux kernel and a GNU or BusyBox userland (UNIX-like)

Android-based.label: Android
Android-based.hint: Android and its forks: Linux kernel with the AOSP userland (Bionic, Toybox)

iOS-based.label: iOS
iOS-based.hint: Apple mobile, TV, watch and headset systems: Darwin with the iOS frameworks

BSD.hint: FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD, DragonFly and derivatives (UNIX-like, descended from Berkeley UNIX)

UNIX.hint: Certified or System V-lineage UNIX: Solaris, AIX, HP-UX, z/OS, illumos

Other UNIX-like.label: UNIX-like
Other UNIX-like.hint: UNIX-like systems written from scratch or in their own lineage (Redox, SerenityOS, Plan 9, MINIX, RTOSes with a POSIX API...)

Other.label: Independents
Other.hint: Not UNIX and not a known family: DOS, Amiga, Haiku, Fuchsia, HarmonyOS, proprietary consoles...
